To put battery cartons away:

- **Location:** Put battery packs away only in fire cells BAT-Z1 to BAT-Z4 within Manchester main stores, booked in Ledgerline to warehouse WH-MAN-STR (the legacy code WH-MAN-BAT is merged and prohibited) [6][28].
- **Capacity limits:** Check the cell’s count board first; each cell holds at most 1,500 packs, giving an area ceiling of 6,000 packs [6][28].
- **Handling and stacking:** Move packs only in their cartons on a pallet, and never stack cartons more than four high [28]. 
- **Storage conditions:** Packs must remain at a state of charge between 30% and 50%, and stores staff must never charge packs in the store [6].
- **Dropped stock:** A dropped carton must be quarantined immediately in the red bin in cell BAT-Z4, even if it looks undamaged [6][28][41].
- **Receipt routing:** Voltway battery packs (BAT-*) go directly into WH-MAN-STR after AQL sampling, while all other lithium-cell parts enter WH-MAN-QC until released [46][544].

`ERR-PO-0412` means the tax code on the purchase order does not match the supplier’s country [50][53]. Pressing **Fetch** (`F3`) automatically defaults the tax code to `VAT20-UK` (for UK suppliers), but suppliers outside the UK require a reverse-charge code [35][50][53]. (Note: Patch 7.2.3-P1 updated the message text to `TAX CODE DOES NOT MATCH SUPPLIER COUNTRY (<country>)` [481][602].)

**How to fix it:**
1. Check the supplier's two-letter country code displayed in brackets in the error message [50][602].
2. If the supplier is outside the UK, change the tax code to the corresponding reverse-charge code, such as `VAT20-RC` (or `VAT5-RC` for reduced-rate items) [35][50][602]. For a UK supplier, ensure `VAT20-UK` is set [602].
3. Press **F8** to save the order again [50][53][602].

No. In Ledgerline ERP 7.2, saving a certificate (service `sup_cert_upload`) does not check its dates [375]. 

Ledgerline records who uploaded the certificate and when, but it keeps expired certificates on file and does not validate dates on save [53][375]. Checking the certificate's issue date and valid-to date must be done manually by purchasing staff and verified by the senior buyer before an order is placed [2][13][33].

Under Purchase Policy POL-PUR-001 §7.2, any order at a rate more than 2% above the current contract rate requires the manager's written reason in the remarks [10]. 

Previously, under policy version 4.0, the price tolerance was 5%, but it was reduced from 5% to 2% with effect from 1 April 2026 in version 4.1 [10].
Under the Data Retention Policy (POL-DRP-009), e-mail is kept for 3 years and is owned by IT [7].

`ERR-WO-0310` means **COMPONENT SHORTAGE (<itm_cd>)** [50][52][465]. 

It is raised by service `wo_release` on the Work Order screen (PRD-WO-01) when attempting to release a work order that has insufficient free stock for an allocated component or sub-assembly [31][50][52][344].

To cancel a purchase order:

1. Open the order on screen **PUR-POM-06** and press **Fetch** [36][53].
2. Press **Cancel** and enter a mandatory cancellation reason [36][53].
3. The status changes to **CN** (Cancelled), committed budget is released, and for a released order, the quantity is removed from stock on order [53]. Orders already in status **CN**, **RJ**, or **CL** cannot be cancelled or amended (returning **ERR-PO-0801**) [36][53].

**Notifying the supplier:**
Ledgerline sends no cancellation notice automatically [36][53]. You must e-mail the supplier yourself on the same day and secure their written acknowledgement [36]. Keep the cancellation e-mail, supplier acknowledgement, and original quotation in the order file [36]. If an order is cancelled after delivery has begun, send copies of the paperwork immediately to the goods inward desk to prevent unauthorised receipt [36].

At the current contract rate and quote, the figures for 2,000 BAT-500 battery packs are:

- **Voltway Cells**: At the contract rate of £119.00 per pack in force since 1 October 2026 [551][593], the basic value is £238,000, VAT (20%) is £47,600, and the full gross price is **£285,600** [5].
- **Brightcell Energy**: At the quoted rate of £104.00 per pack delivered (DAP Manchester) [561], the basic value is £208,000 [561]. With 20% VAT (reverse charge code VAT20-RC) [10][467], VAT is £41,600, giving a full gross price of **£249,600** [10][561].

This represents a difference of £36,000 gross (£30,000 basic) [5][561]. 

*(Note: Under Purchase Policy §6.2, §6.4, and AMD-SUP-2026-02, Brightcell cannot be ordered today because they are not onboarded, their UN 38.3 certificate is pending renewal, and a cheaper quote alone does not justify switching suppliers [10][564].)*

The required (mandatory) fields for the service `pr_approve` (PR APPROVE/REJECT) are:

- `pr_no` (PR NO, type `str`) [56][364]
- `decision` (A/R, type `str`) [56][364]

The field `comment` is optional [56][364].

In Ledgerline ERP 7.2, **ERR-MAT-0420** has the message text **"OVERRIDE NEEDS AP-MGR ROLE"** [48][50][107][465].

It is raised by the `mat_override` service on screen AP-MAT-02 when a user attempts to override a three-way match without holding the Accounts Payable Manager (`AP-MGR`) role [21][50][107]. Only the AP manager is permitted to override a match; for anyone else, the system refuses the action with this error [21]. 

*(Note: Although section 4 narrative of MAN-AP-72 mentions ERR-MAT-0420 regarding a quantity variance, the official error code catalogue, service definitions, and SOP-AP-001 confirm the rule and message as "OVERRIDE NEEDS AP-MGR ROLE" [21][48][50][107]).*

According to the integration inventory and system design notes, the purchasing bot pilot interface (ID: INT-007, using integration account SVC_AGENT) has no owner listed (`(none)`) [635][636]. It has no named owner and is currently under review following audit finding ITS-2026-07 [9][636].
